cards.main_contribution: 提出了基于图神经网络的图总结方法，特别是GSAERU模型。
overlaps: 都讨论了图神经网络的应用
differences: GSAERU模型特别强调大规模时序图的表示学习
其他工作可能侧重于不同的应用场景或目标

quotes.quote: In the past, most graph summarization techniques sought to capture the most important part of a graph statistically. However, today, the high dimensionality and complexity of modern graph data are making deep learning techniques more popular.
quotes.interpretation: 过去的图总结技术主要通过统计方式捕捉图的重要部分，但现代图数据的高度复杂性和高维度使得深度学习技术更加流行。

quotes.quote: Our investigation includes a review of the current state-of-the-art approaches, including recurrent GNNs, convolutional GNNs, graph autoencoders, and graph attention networks.
quotes.interpretation: 我们的调查包括对当前最先进的方法的回顾，包括循环图神经网络、卷积图神经网络、图自编码器和图注意力网络。
